items.title: Mitch Johnson hinted could be minutes for rookies Tarris Reed, Ja'Kobi Gillespie and Maliq Brown vs. Kings.
items.author: Jeff McDonald
items.body_excerpt:
Mitch Johnson hinted could be minutes for rookies Tarris Reed, Ja'Kobi Gillespie and Maliq Brown vs. Kings.

"If they play great, how good for them? And if they’re awful, what a learning lesson. ... 24 hours from now they’ll have a whole new perspective on whatever they go through tonight."
